customSections.label: Family Planning: Breaks and Other No-School Days
customSections.content: Outside the three longer no-school periods below, UCPS lists 12 additional weekdays off for students on the traditional calendar: September 7 and 21; October 19; November 3 and 11; January 15 and 18; February 15; March 2 and 26; April 30; and May 31.

definitions.description: Students are out Wednesday through Friday, November 25–27. UCPS marks November 25 as an optional teacher workday and November 26–27 as holidays.

Students are out December 21–January 1. UCPS marks December 21 as an optional teacher workday; December 22–23 and 29–31 as annual leave; and December 24–25, December 28, and January 1 as holidays. Students return January 4.
UCPS marks Friday, March 26 as a holiday, followed by annual leave March 29–April 2. Students therefore have six consecutive weekdays without school from March 26 through April 2.

customSections.label: What’s New for 2026–27
customSections.content: Changes families may notice from the UCPS 2025–26 traditional calendar previously reviewed by MySchoolDates.

definitions.description: School starts August 24, one day earlier than in 2025–26.
School ends June 4, one day earlier than in 2025–26.
The annual-leave week moves from April 6–10 in 2025–26 to March 29–April 2 in 2026–27. Students are also off March 26, immediately before the annual-leave week.
Students remain out for three weekdays, Wednesday through Friday.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 11, 2026 using the official UCPS 2026–27 Traditional Schools Academic Calendar and district calendar page.
sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed 175 instructional days, with 86 student days in the first semester and 89 in the second.
Checked every color-coded student no-school date in the official PDF, including the November 3 and March 2 district professional-development teacher workdays.
Grouped Thanksgiving, winter, and spring dates into parent-friendly no-school periods while preserving the official teacher-workday, annual-leave, and holiday categories in the descriptions.

We also checked the Early College and Wolfe School calendars to confirm that those schools follow separate schedules; their dates are not included in this page’s traditional calendar table or ICS file.
The ICS file uses the same reviewed traditional calendar dates shown on this page and does not update automatically after district revisions.
